facts.note: At nine, the temple bell; Aurèle had everyone bring out watches and checked them. Vauthier's watch was two minutes ahead of the bell.
Piquet in the salon until a quarter to eleven by Vauthier's watch; he went to the hall for his cigar case in his coat; Madame began the piano as he went out and stopped when he returned.
At the temple's ten during the game, the salon clock showed five minutes to ten, and Vauthier remarked on it to Madame.

added.quote: Only the regulator on the wall, which had stopped.
added.why: A wall clock had stopped, and the next line ties its stopping to the master's death. A detective could read its stopped hands as a time of death, though the transcript gives no reading.
